title: Design of a 3D nanowire-CuO/LDH@FeNi-γAl2O3 catalyst and its synergistic mechanism for accelerated dye degradation in wastewater
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1682-1696
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06641G, Paper
Open Access

Guene L. Razack, Jie Ding, Xian Zhao, Ya-Ni Zang, Chen-Hao Cui, Wen-Shuo Wang, Ji-Wei Pang, Lu-Yan Zhang, Worou Chabi Noel, Assogba Dou Rached, Nan-Qi Ren, Shan-Shan Yang
The heterojunction of γAl2O3 × FNCL@CuO particles was elucidated. The excellent degradation of dyes and stability of particles were demonstrated. The mechanism of dye removal in the 3D system has been elucidated.
